newsitem.title: JAPAN: Two hurt near disputed islands - Japan coastguard.
newsitem.headline: Two hurt near disputed islands - Japan coastguard.

text.p: Two men from a Hong Kong ship trying to land on a group of disputed islands in the East China Sea were seriously injured after jumping overboard, Japan's Maritime Safety Agency said on Thursday.
It said one of the men was taken by helicopter to a hospital in the southern Japanese prefecture of Okinawa and the second was being treated by the Japanese coastguard on the Hong Kong ship.
The agency said the two men were not identified.
Hong Kong radio and cable TV said earlier that one of the men was David Chan, leader of a group contesting Japan's claim to the islands, called the Senkakus in Japan and the Diaoyus in Chinese.
The islands are claimed by China, Taiwan and Japan.
The Hong Kong report said Chan was feared dead. The Japanese coastguard said efforts were being made to resuscitate one of the men.

The agency said that four men in all jumped off the Hong Kong ship. The other two were rescued uninjured. The agency said the captain of the Hong Kong ship asked for assistance around 11 a.m. local time (0200 GMT).
